set_mkl_num_threads: set MKL library thread count to 1 to prevent thread explosion during computation
working_dir_resolver: resolve a relative path string to an absolute file URI using the project root working directory
setup_conf: register Hydra config groups and the omegaconf realpath resolver for the LCM project
torch_type: convert a dtype string from a checkpoint into a torch.dtype object for model loading
promote_config: promote a dict or DictConfig into a typed config class instance using dacite
